source_caption:
🎬 Curb Your Enthusiasm (2000–2024)

Curb Your Enthusiasm follows Larry David, the outspoken and socially awkward co-creator of Seinfeld, as he navigates everyday life in Los Angeles while constantly finding himself trapped in hilarious misunderstandings, uncomfortable conversations, and completely unnecessary arguments. Playing a fictionalized version of himself, Larry enjoys a successful career and comfortable lifestyle, but his inability to ignore minor annoyances frequently turns ordinary situations into outrageous disasters. Whether attending dinner parties, visiting friends, dealing with restaurant employees, or questioning social traditions, Larry’s obsession with fairness, honesty, and unwritten rules creates endless conflicts with nearly everyone he encounters. His interactions with longtime friends, family members, celebrities, and strangers often begin innocently before spiraling into embarrassing confrontations and unexpected consequences. Meanwhile, his complicated relationships with his wife Cheryl, manager Jeff Greene, and outspoken houseguest Leon Black add even more chaos to his unpredictable life. From ridiculous misunderstandings and awkward public encounters to elaborate schemes and unforgettable arguments, Larry repeatedly discovers that even the smallest social mistake can lead to enormous problems. Despite his questionable decisions and stubborn personality, his experiences reveal the absurdity of everyday expectations and human behavior. Combining sharp observational humor, improvisational performances, unforgettable characters, and brilliantly uncomfortable situations, the series explores friendship, relationships, social etiquette, selfishness, and the hilarious consequences of saying exactly what everyone else is thinking.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Sitcom • Satire

⭐ IMDb: 8.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 30–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Larry David

📺 Where to Watch: HBO Max. Digital purchase options may also be available through Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Curb Your Enthusiasm, also known colloquially as Curb, is an American comedy television series created by Larry David that premiered on HBO with an hour-long special on October 17, 1999, followed by 12 seasons broadcast from 2000 to 2024. David stars as a fictionalized version of himself and the show follows his life as a semi-retired television writer and producer in Los Angeles and, for one season each, New York City and Atlanta. Also starring are Cheryl Hines as his wife Cheryl, Jeff Garlin as his manager and best friend Jeff Greene, Susie Essman as Jeff's wife Susie, and J. B. Smoove as Larry's housemate Leon Black.
